Factory Acceptance Test – Protocol and Report
Control system
Document no. FAT-TP201-C
Revision 0
Issue date 14-Jan-2026
Equipment TP-201 – Rotary tablet press (single-sided)
Serial no. RTP36-25-0417
Manufacturer Pressora Maschinenbau GmbH
1. Purpose
This document defines and records the factory acceptance tests (control system) of the rotary tablet press (single-sided) at the manufacturer's works, before shipment to the customer.
2. Approval before execution
Role Name Company Signature Date
Prepared by Markus Brandt Pressora Maschinenbau GmbH Signed electronically 14-Jan-2026
Checked by
Approved by
3. Test results
Pass/Fail is recorded against the acceptance criterion of each step.
Step Test Acceptance criterion Result Pass/ Fail
FAT-C-01 Simulate a tablet weight drift; confirm the force-based weight control corrects it. Present and functional Present and functional Pass
FAT-C-02 Feed out-of-limit tablets; confirm they are rejected automatically. Present and functional Present and functional Pass
FAT-C-03 Change a parameter and a recipe on the HMI; confirm both appear in the audit trail. Present and functional Present and functional Pass
4. Deviations
None recorded.
